wages.text: Meng backed One Fair Wage to end the sub-minimum tipped wage and support restaurant workers.
wages.quote: We need to pass One Fair Wage to help the industry recover from the pandemic and to thrive.

debt.text: Meng says she will oppose any cuts to Social Security and Medicare and work to preserve seniors' earned benefits.
debt.quote: I will continue to oppose cuts to these programs in any form.

housing.text: Meng backs housing as a human right and has introduced bills funding affordable housing infrastructure.
housing.quote: Grace is fighting for housing justice for everyone in Queens, because she believes everyone deserves affordable, clean, and safe housing.

schools.text: Meng says she values the public education system and opposes efforts to marginalize it.
schools.quote: As a product of the New York City schools, I appreciate the value of a strong public education system and oppose attempts to marginalize it.

immigration.text: Meng introduced legislation to update the immigration registry to create a path to permanent legal status for millions of immigrants.
immigration.quote: This nation was built by immigrants and we must continue to make sure that all who want to become new Americans have that opportunity.

guns.text: Meng called the Senate's failure to expand gun background checks a major setback and champions universal background checks.
guns.quote: The Senate's rejection of expanded background checks for gun purchases is extremely disappointing, and it's a major setback in our efforts to keep guns out of the hands of those who should not possess them.

abortion.text: Meng denounced the overturning of Roe v. Wade and has pushed to codify abortion rights nationwide.
abortion.quote: The decision to strike down Roe v. Wade is outrageous, unacceptable and unconscionable, and it's an all-out assault on reproductive freedom.

gender.text: Meng, a Vice Chair of the LGBTQ+ Equality Caucus and Equality Act cosponsor, affirms the rights of LGBTQ+ people including transgender individuals.
gender.quote: Pride Month allows people to bravely embrace their identities that have for too long been marginalized, attacked, and disgraced.

health.text: Meng, a Medicare for All Caucus member, says affordable health care is a right, not a privilege.
health.quote: I believe that affordable health care is not a privilege, but a right.

energy.text: Meng introduced legislation to reduce atmospheric carbon and warns of the consequences of climate change.
energy.quote: We must take action to reduce the amount of carbon in our atmosphere.

voting.text: Meng cosponsored the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to strengthen protections against voting discrimination.
voting.quote: I am proud to co-sponsor the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to ensure our country's system of governance, by the people and for the people, endures for generations to come.
